July 7's open above $200 will determine whether this is a genuine breakout or a false trigger.

**Volume.** Full trading session estimated ~300M shares — above the 200M gate threshold. The gate 3 volume condition is met. Morning's partial ~166M (pre-market) reflected the pre-open float only; the US session added meaningful institutional participation.
